status: Frozen before implementation and numerical case evaluation. No training or use of previous confirmation data.

model.mandatory_refractory: a>0, frozen at r, no rewards while refractory
model.terminal_active_payoff: max(X-c,0), counted once as terminal liquidation

upper_domain: At least c+1/lambda+2dx; exact immediate-spike boundary by single-stopping comparison.

quadrature.normalization: No row normalization. Report raw killed-mass defects and omitted lower-tail mass separately.

policy_crosscheck: Extract the LCP upper-ray boundary on each time interval; evaluate exactly the same schedule using positive killed-density quadrature, analytic H and discounted first-hit time moment. Only spatial interpolation and delayed reset-value time interpolation remain. dt<a and a/dt integer.
fixed_policy_refinement: On each finest-grid policy, halve evaluation dt and dx, repeat each existing threshold twice, and use order16; never optimize the refined evaluator policy.

gates.expiry_boundary_tolerance: 3*sigma*sqrt(dt)+2*dx against c+max(mu,0)/q on first positive time layer
gates.upper_ray: required at every positive time layer
gates.pending_release: must use actual remaining horizon and current threshold schedule; no event while held

verification_limits: LCP residual certifies the discrete complementarity system only.
Neither refinement differences nor policy-vs-LCP agreement are a rigorous continuous optimality-gap certificate.
The infinite-horizon bound certifies only lower spatial truncation loss.

Global model scope is one constant-coefficient scalar diffusion with fixed reset, linear spike reward and positive mandatory refractory time; no multi-neuron, learned-dynamics or cross-task superiority claim.
failure_policy: Preserve failed source hash, full log and result before numerical bug repair. Do not change cases or thresholds to make a failure pass.
